# Gateway routes API

Route a verified hostname to a workload, workflow, URL, or object bucket. Set the identifier matching target_kind.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/gateway_route` | [List gateway routes](#op-get-v1-gateway-route) |
| `POST` | `/v1/gateway_route` | [Create gateway route](#op-post-v1-gateway-route) |
| `GET` | `/v1/gateway_route/{id}` | [Get gateway route](#op-get-v1-gateway-route-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/gateway_route/{id}` | [Update gateway route](#op-put-v1-gateway-route-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/gateway_route/{id}` | [Delete gateway route](#op-delete-v1-gateway-route-id) |

## List gateway routes {#op-get-v1-gateway-route}

`GET /v1/gateway_route`

Returns a paginated list of GatewayRoute

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/gateway_route" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of GatewayRoute

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].auth_policy` | object | Gateway user auth policy. This is app-facing auth, not API/admin auth. |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].enabled` | boolean |  |
| `data[].exposure` | string |  Allowed: public, auth, private. |
| `data[].geo_policy` | object | Optional country allow/block policy |
| `data[].hostname` | string |  |
| `data[].object_bucket_id` | string |  |
| `data[].path_prefix` | string |  |
| `data[].priority` | integer |  |
| `data[].rewrite_to` | string | Optional rewrite path applied before proxying (for example /v1) |
| `data[].route_id` | string |  |
| `data[].security_policy` | object | Optional route-level HTTP security override |
| `data[].strip_prefix` | boolean |  |
| `data[].target_kind` | string |  Allowed: workload, workflow, url, object_storage. |
| `data[].target_url` | string | Absolute URL used when target_kind=url |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].traffic_policy` | object | Optional route-level regional traffic policy for gateway target selection |
| `data[].trigger_name` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workflow_id` | string |  |
| `data[].workload_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

    }

## Create gateway route {#op-post-v1-gateway-route}

`POST /v1/gateway_route`

Creates a new GatewayRoute

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Request fields (the body contains an editable example):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth_policy` | object | no | Gateway user auth policy. This is app-facing auth, not API/admin auth. |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  Default: `true`. |
| `exposure` | string | yes |  Allowed: public, auth, private. Default: `"public"`. |
| `geo_policy` | object | no | Optional country allow/block policy |
| `hostname` | string | yes |  |
| `object_bucket_id` | string | no |  |
| `path_prefix` | string | yes |  Default: `"/"`. |
| `priority` | integer | yes |  Default: `0`. |
| `rewrite_to` | string | no | Optional rewrite path applied before proxying (for example /v1) |
| `security_policy` | object | no | Optional route-level HTTP security override |
| `strip_prefix` | boolean | yes |  Default: `false`. |
| `target_kind` | string | yes |  Allowed: workload, workflow, url, object_storage. Default: `"workload"`. |
| `target_url` | string | no | Absolute URL used when target_kind=url |
| `team_id` | string | yes |  |
| `traffic_policy` | object | no | Optional route-level regional traffic policy for gateway target selection |
| `trigger_name` | string | no |  |
| `workflow_id` | string | no |  |
| `workload_id` | string | no |  |

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request POST "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/gateway_route" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "team_id": "YOUR_TEAM_ID",
  "hostname": "YOUR_HOSTNAME",
  "path_prefix": "/",
  "target_kind": "workload",
  "workload_id": "YOUR_WORKLOAD_ID",
  "exposure": "public",
  "priority": 0,
  "strip_prefix": false,
  "enabled": true
}
JSON
```

Replace `YOUR_*` body placeholders before sending. The quoted heredoc keeps the JSON literal.

### Response: HTTP 201

GatewayRoute created

### Response fields

| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth_policy` | object | Gateway user auth policy. This is app-facing auth, not API/admin auth. |
| `created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |

| `enabled` | boolean |  |
| `exposure` | string |  Allowed: public, auth, private. |
| `geo_policy` | object | Optional country allow/block policy |

| `route_id` | string |  |
| `security_policy` | object | Optional route-level HTTP security override |
| `strip_prefix` | boolean |  |
| `target_kind` | string |  Allowed: workload, workflow, url, object_storage. |
| `target_url` | string | Absolute URL used when target_kind=url |
| `team_id` | string |  |
| `traffic_policy` | object | Optional route-level regional traffic policy for gateway target selection |
